proposed_new_caps.formula: 26 * ((131072 * 0.30 + 4096 * 2.50) / 1000000). Input/window bound and existing wire-byte guard are conservatively retained, not replaced by observed usage or guessed smaller inputs.
proposed_new_caps.finite_repair_controls: Current RequestBudget permits at most 4 total calls/180 active seconds; all teacher, checker, format repair, contract correction, semantic repair and eligible transient attempts consume the same 4. Teacher format repair at most 1; semantic revision at most 1; checker evaluations at most 2, or 3 under the explicitly selected schema-corrections policy; transient counter at most 2. These are intersecting limits, not additive call allowances.
proposed_new_caps.no_shortened_quality_path: Keep the current normal 4-call ceiling; do not copy the old native runner's special 3-call limit. A failed repair/recheck remains failed. No schema fields, evidence, scientific conditions, checking or teaching gates are removed to make time or quality pass.
proposed_new_caps.transport_and_failure_accounting: Persist a unique full hold before every provider POST. Observed errors and attempts count against caps. UNKNOWN cost retains the full hold, is never assigned zero, and stops the job/phase without replay. No timeout, transport error, failed question, regeneration, alternate provider or replacement question receives an extra allowance. A later new trial is allowed only if explicitly scheduled inside the frozen 6-answer plan.

questions: How do simple diffusion and facilitated diffusion differ?
inputs_and_isolation.session_conditions: One fresh synthetic actor/session per answer; no prior chat, memory/profile, Gold, choices or evaluator prerequisites; no regeneration or answer reuse.
inputs_and_isolation.corpus: New isolated owned PostgreSQL fixture rebuilt from the explicitly public source-only corpus defining the prior 4-document/10594-chunk native experiment. Do not read/copy a protected private DB, switch the installed 32639-chunk mock runtime, or silently compare different corpora. Record release/chunk/input hashes before any API call.
inputs_and_isolation.shared_retrieval_conditions: Same current source, corpus, fixed chunking, token/context budget, top-5 submitted evidence, machine/device, queue/polling and teacher/checker configuration. Only the explicitly frozen Dense versus RRF+MiniLM retrieval policy differs. Reranker/embedding model revisions are pinned to existing public caches. Native retrieval runs per request; no precomputed model answer or bypass of packing/checker.
inputs_and_isolation.evidence_repeat_control: Record candidates, packed submitted fragments, source/quote bounds and hashes. Repeated same-question/same-arm inputs must be reproducible. Any changed candidate/packing set is reported as input variation; no best answer or fastest run selection.
inputs_and_isolation.Gold: No Gold/reference map is read by this plan or sent to a runtime/model. For these two free-text questions, freeze public-source rubrics locally before paid execution.

warmup_and_measurement.local_preparation: Load fixed local embedding/reranking weights for both arms using fresh owned processes; record readiness/model-load time separately. No model answer inference occurs before each timed message. No live connectivity probe outside the 2 admitted project role probes.
warmup_and_measurement.cold_limit: Exactly one first native answer per arm, included in all call/cost/quality counts but reported separately from the warm timing summary. These are first-answer/warmup observations; do not claim truly cold OS/disk/provider caches. No repeated paid warmup or reset until a desired time appears.
warmup_and_measurement.primary_native_start: Monotonic client timer immediately before normal POST /api/sessions/{session_id}/messages, including request serialization/transport.
warmup_and_measurement.primary_native_end: After the same job is terminal succeeded, normal GET /api/answers/{answer_id} has fully returned, decoded, and passed complete response/job/request identity validation. Persist exact endpoint and boundary in the future runner.
warmup_and_measurement.included: Native HTTP submit, queue wait, query preparation, local retrieval/reranking, packing, every teacher/checker/repair call, worker publication/DB commit, polling and complete answer GET/validation.
warmup_and_measurement.excluded_and_reported_separately: Service/model load and role qualification before message submission; optional expanded evidence/transcript reads and UI rendering after primary native end. This is complete native answer availability, not browser-render latency. A later browser render timer must be separately implemented before a UI latency claim.
warmup_and_measurement.observed_36_adapter_timing_for_interview: Existing 36-answer timing starts before adapter.generate and ends when the complete provider result returns, before local response validation. Model google/gemini-3.5-flash-lite via OpenRouter google-vertex/global; it excludes retrieval, packing, checker, native HTTP/queue/polling and UI. Median/p95 seconds: E0 1.136159/1.53374121; Dense 1.1897339/1.81544283; Hybrid 1.07703885/1.321302825. Never present these as native complete-answer timings.

preregistered_quality_and_latency_gate.quality_denominators: All 6 scheduled answers remain in strict publication/quality accounting; all 4 warm answers remain in warm comparisons. Failed, refused, partial, schema-invalid, checker-unavailable, unsupported, uncited, incomplete or timed-out answers are not dropped or treated as fast successes.
preregistered_quality_and_latency_gate.quality: Every native answer must pass the unchanged complete teacher schema, full checker/evidence and teaching/publication contract. Separately perform local public-source semantic review, label it AI-assisted local review rather than human rating, preserve uncertainty and checker disagreement, and require scientifically correct complete answers for both questions. No per-question semantic quality downgrade is permitted for Hybrid relative to Dense.
preregistered_quality_and_latency_gate.homeostasis_rubric: Correctly explain regulated relatively stable internal conditions despite change, with dynamic regulation rather than a fixed external environment or literal unchanging state. Any extra mechanism/example must be supported by actual submitted source evidence.
preregistered_quality_and_latency_gate.diffusion_rubric: Distinguish direct membrane passage in simple diffusion from channel/carrier assistance in facilitated diffusion, both passive down their relevant gradient without direct ATP expenditure; qualify substrate and membrane conditions if stated, and do not turn facilitated diffusion into active uphill transport. Actual submitted citations must support the conditions claimed.
preregistered_quality_and_latency_gate.absolute_target: Report each complete answer and descriptive warm p95 against <=10 seconds, with <=5 seconds as an additional marker. Faster than 5 seconds is not a failure.
preregistered_quality_and_latency_gate.relative_target: Describe (Dense p95 - Hybrid p95)/Dense p95, but do not claim the >=30% warm p95 requirement or statistical quality non-inferiority is validated.
preregistered_quality_and_latency_gate.statistics: Only 2 warm observations per arm, one per question. Linear quantile (n-1)*q may be reported descriptively with min/max, all values, failures and scheduled denominators. No confidence/significance/generalization or held-out claim; this tiny pilot cannot characterize tails or prove non-inferiority.
